fact: MoCTI, with World Bank-funded SLDTP support, handed over a second set of assistive devices (computers with NVDA screen-reader software, Braille note takers and embossers, scanners and book readers, braillers, digital recorders) to four disability institutions in Makeni, Kenema and Freetown, after an early 2024 phase to two Freetown schools.

fact: Sierra Leone's Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation and the Ministry of Social Welfare validated the UNICEF-sponsored Leh Wi Tok communication app for speech- and hearing-impaired people, with a first phase for school pupils, and the Social Welfare minister plans to present it for cabinet approval.
